study: M8 referee assignment history vs Crown T12 AH payout; historical only
status: walk-forward retrospective; referee data first-known time unverified; not a production candidate

method.target: home AH unit return minus away AH unit return under same Crown T12 line and prices
method.features: Crown market line and normalized home implied probability; prior same-competition referee-vs-Crown margin residual and history count, 730-day lookback; target date and previous two calendar dates excluded. Incomplete player-appearance/card records were audited and excluded from model features
method.train: expanding all prior years, separate calendar-year folds 2024/2025/2026; fixed ridge alpha=100; no target-year labels or future M8 membership in features

outside15_scope_note: Current Transfermarkt referee/team archive maps to the 25 explicit M8 competition codes only. No 15-league event-time AH outcome cohort was produced by this experiment; new-league receipts/signals are not represented and this limitation is preserved.
